exercises.explanationUz:
9-10-UNITLAR TESTI - 20 savol.

  MODAL: 1 She COULD be (ehtimol),
    5 It MIGHT be cold, 7 You AREN'T
    ALLOWED to smoke (+to), 10
    She'll HAVE TO study (will +
    have to), 14 he COULDN'T swim
    (o'tgan)
  HAVE TO: 4 DOESN'T have to
    (shart emas), 8 she HAD to
    (o'tgan)
  TOO / ENOUGH: 2 TOO dark to read,
    16 isn't strong ENOUGH, 19
    TOO loud
  O'ZLIK OLMOShI: 3 burn YOURSELF
    (you), 12 Angie ... by HERSELF
  PASSIV: 6 should be KEPT, 9 was
    WRITTEN by, 13 has already BEEN
    baked, 15 is MADE, 17 The cows
    HAVE already been milked, 20
    will be HELD
  BUYRUQ: 11 Don't COME, 18 PUT
    that knife down

  ⚠ 'must' dan keyin will
  ishlatilmaydi: She'll HAVE TO.


⚠ 'MAPLE SYRUP':

  = zarang siropi.

9-10-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  MAJHUL NISBAT: WAS written by
    Dickens; will BE invited; Has
    the gallery BEEN opened?; WAS
    destroyed in 1788; WHEN was the
    museum completed?; was used AS
    a place of worship; You'll BE
    amazed
  O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI: enjoyed
    OURSELVES; cut YOURSELF
  TOO / ENOUGH: isn't old ENOUGH to
    drive; TOO cold to play
  QOIDALAR: children MUSTN'T play
    near ponds; You aren't ALLOWED
    to smoke; stay AWAY from; NEVER
    play with matches; Don't LET
    your children ...; You SHOULD
    cover sockets
  Boshqa: WHOSE collection?;
    NEITHER do I; WHAT's her job?


⚠ 'A PLACE OF WORSHIP':

  = ibodat joyi.


⚠ 'ELECTRICAL SOCKETS':

  = elektr rozetkalari.

exercises.explanationUz:
9-10-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 CHARGE for admission = kirish
    uchun haq olmoq
  2 America was DISCOVERED = kashf
    etilgan
  3 is LOCATED in Paris = joylashgan
  4 an electric SHOCK = tok urishi
  5 SHARP teeth = o'tkir tishlar
  6 Help ME = menga yordam ber
  7 opened BY the Queen (majhul
    bajaruvchi)
  8 you'll FALL into the pond =
    yiqilasan
  9 the EXHIBITS in a museum
  10 seriously INJURED = jiddiy
    jarohatlangan


⚠ 'HURT' va 'INJURED':

  Ikkalasi ham jarohat; 'seriously
  injured' - rasmiy ibora (baxtsiz
  hodisa). 'damaged' - faqat
  narsalar uchun.

exercises.explanationUz:
MUZEY VA MAJHUL NISBAT
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 'Admission is £10' → How much
    is it to get in?
  2 'I'm afraid not' → Can I take
    photographs?
  3 'I have to ... ' → So do I, but
    ...
  4 'made of leather' → What is
    your jacket made of?
  5 'Alexander Graham Bell' → Who
    was the telephone invented by?


⚠ 'ADMISSION':

  = kirish (haqi).


⚠ 'SO DO I':

  = men ham (tasdiqqa qo'shilish).

sentencePatterns.formula: too + SIFAT + to + FE'L / SIFAT + enough + for + KIM
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is too dark to read. The coffee isn't strong enough for me.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'qish uchun juda qorong'i. Qahva men uchun yetarlicha kuchli emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + will be / has been / should be + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The meeting will be held tomorrow. The cake has already been baked.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yig'ilish ertaga o'tkaziladi. Tort allaqachon pishirilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + will have to / had to / doesn't have to + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She'll have to study harder. She had to take piano lessons. Brenda doesn't have to clean.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ko'proq o'qishi kerak bo'ladi. U pianino darsiga borishi kerak edi. Brendaga tozalash shart emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: NIMA + was/will be/has been + V3 (+ by KIM)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: David Copperfield was written by Charles Dickens. The museum will be opened by the Queen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 'Devid Kopperfild' Charlz Dikkens tomonidan yozilgan. Muzey qirolicha tomonidan ochiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: too + SIFAT + to FE'L / SIFAT + enough + to FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's too cold to play in the garden. He isn't old enough to drive a car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog'da o'ynash uchun juda sovuq. U mashina haydash uchun yetarlicha katta emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We enjoyed ourselves a lot. Be careful or you'll cut yourself.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Biz juda maza qildik. Ehtiyot bo'l, o'zingni kesib olasan.

sentencePatterns.formula: So do I. / Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have to do the ironing. - So do I. / I don't have to water the plants. - Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dazmol qilishim kerak. - Men ham. / Gullarni sug'orishim shart emas. - Men ham.
